tds.declaration_reminder.title: TDS declaration for {fy} — open until {to}
tds.declaration_reminder.body: Declare your tax regime and planned investments for {fy} on Statutory & Compliance → TDS Declaration before {to}. {state} Without a declaration, TDS is deducted under the default regime on salary alone.
tds.declaration_reminder.audience_note: On the day the window opens (everyone) and on each reminder day before it closes (only those who have not declared). Deduped per person per day.

tds.proof_reminder.title: Upload your investment proofs for {fy} by {to}
tds.proof_reminder.body: Proofs still missing: {items}. Upload them on Statutory & Compliance → Investment Proofs before {to}. After the cut-off, items without an approved proof stop reducing your tax and the remaining months' TDS goes up.
tds.proof_reminder.audience_note: Only employees with declared items still unproven, on the window's first day and each reminder day.

tds.proof_reviewed.title: Your investment proof was {decision}
tds.proof_reviewed.audience_note: The employee whose proof it is, once HR decides.
